name: Enquiry Form
description: A contact page that collects enquiries from visitors, an inbox in this dashboard to follow them up, and an optional floating button on every page.
author: NextPluggable

pages.title: Contact us
pages.description: The page with the enquiry form.

settings.label: Introduction
settings.default: Leave your details and we will get back to you within one working day.

settings.label: Thank-you message
settings.default: Thank you. We have received your enquiry and will be in touch soon.

settings.label: Show a floating button on every page
settings.help: A small button in the corner of the screen that takes visitors to the form.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.help: Leave empty to use your site's own colour.

settings.label: Notification webhook
settings.help: Optional. Each new enquiry is also sent to this address, for example a Slack, Zapier or Make webhook.
